title: Fake-tides control
interpretation: Real-tides multi-band vs full-band: median +2.19%, CI95 [+1.56, +2.89].
Fake-tides multi-band vs full-band: median +1.70%, CI95 [+0.74, +2.60].

Real tides BEAT fake tides (median +0.58%, CI95 [+0.37, +0.73]). The real gravitational tidal frequencies carry predictive signal that fake non-physical frequencies do not. This is direct evidence that the gravitational tidal structure is operationally relevant, not just any low-frequency coherence.
pre_registered_prediction: If the real gravitational tidal frequencies carry the predictive signal, the real-tides multi-band predictor should beat the fake-tides variant. If the tidal band's contribution is just generic low-frequency coherence, fake tides should work equally well.
